EXAMPLE CHUNK (invented "Acme Orders" domain; replace with your product knowledge).

A refund is allowed within 30 days after delivery of a line. Each refund references one order line and a quantity no larger than the quantity delivered minus the quantity already refunded. The refunded amount is the line unit price times the quantity, plus the proportional tax. Shipping fees are refunded only when the whole order is refunded.

Every refund produces a credit note on the original invoice and returns the money to the original payment method. A refund outside the 30-day window needs manager approval and is recorded with the approver.
